title: Vertex structure of fiber products of probability polytopes
summary: We develop tools for characterizing vertices of fiber products of polytopes and apply them to simplicial distribution polytopes, a class of probability polytopes arising in quantum foundations and quantum information. In the theory of simplicial distributions, a pair of simplicial sets encoding measurement and outcome spaces determines a convex polytope of compatible probability assignments. Our first results give geometric criteria for detecting vertices of fiber products in terms of support data.
